recreation.gov search API (name and campgrounds within 5 miles, 2026-11-20): no Wyoming Horse Creek listing (only Horse Creek, Kaweah Lake CA) -> first-come only, matching the FS page

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (180 m half-width) and z19 tiles at 43.6665,-109.6350 and 43.6677,-109.6355: two loops in open sagebrush with scattered conifers on the west bank of Horse Creek (a braided gravel-bed creek ~17-22 m wide at the campground); the north loop's east spurs sit ~20-30 m from the creek with conifers between; a short spur off the southeast junction ends ~11 m from the creek's gravel bed across open sage (about 43.66638,-109.63490) - not identifiable as a numbered site; the creek is in open view across most of the campground

note: Shoshone NF campground on Horse Creek, 12 miles north of Dubois on Forest Road 285, in open sagebrush with scattered conifers. Bear country: food storage required, bear boxes provided. Fee paid in cash or check. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-10-15) read: 9 sites, 32-ft max spur, FCFS (no rec.gov), 16-day stay limit, $20 cash/check, vault toilets, potable water, bear boxes, mid/late May-Labor Day; Senior/Access 50%. All groups confirmed/written; 16-night max added. Riverview holds (creek in open view; one unnumbered spur ~11 m from the creek - creekside lead). Pin good. Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT 'riverview' HOLDS: Horse Creek (a ~17-22 m gravel-bed creek, so creekside-class, not a river) is in open view across the sagebrush loops; the north loop's east spurs are ~20-30 m back with conifers between. CREEKSIDE LEAD: a short spur off the southeast junction ends ~11 m from the gravel bed across open sage (about 43.66638,-109.63490), but with no site map or rec.gov catalog it cannot be tied to a site number (it may be creek access), so no upgrade.
PHONE (307) 455-2466 (Wind River RD) and WEBSITE (FS r02 page) confirmed.
